text:
alex: RFC review sync — please finalize slots for Tue 10:00 PT (RFC: https://redwood-internal/reviews/rfc-123). Need authors and reviewers assigned.
mei: I can present (author) and will be online. prefer first slot.
sam: I’m reviewer for the related PRs but OOO Tue morning, can do 11:30 PT or Wed.
jordan: Happy to review, can take slot 2 or act as backup reviewer.
alex: Ok @sam can you be backup reviewer if we keep Tue 10? else @jordan you'll be primary?
sam: @alex I can be backup after 10:45, but not primary. If we need primary I can swap with @tara.
tara: I can swap — take the primary reviewer slot Tue 10 if needed.
alex: Great. Pre-read checklist: upload slide + diff link by EOD Fri. Tag reviewers in PR. :memo:
alex: Agenda draft:
```
1) 5m intro + goals
2) 20m walk-through (author)
3) 15m perf & safety notes
4) 15m rollout & rollback plan
5) 5-10m open Qs + action items
```
mei: Suggest we move perf earlier if it's contentious.
jordan: +1 move perf to slot 2 so reviewers have context.
alex: Done — updated agenda and created calendar invite. @calendar-bot can you confirm the invite was sent?
calendar-bot: Event created: "RFC Review — Model routing" Tue 10:00-11:00 PT. Attendees: alex, mei, tara, jordan, sam. Reminder: 1 day before.
alex: Thanks — I'll ping authors for pre-reads Friday morning. :bell:
mei: I'll post slides + perf numbers by Fri 3pm.
sam: I'll review PR once slides are up. :eyes:
alex: Cool — closing slotting. If anything changes, post here.
